name: Rheumatoid Arthritis
definition: Chronic systemic autoimmune inflammatory arthritis that can cause persistent synovitis, erosive joint damage, disability and extra-articular disease.

typical: Persistent symmetrical small-joint pain and swelling

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical supported by serology/inflammation and imaging; serology alone is insufficient.
investigations.MRI: MRI can identify synovitis/erosion in selected uncertain cases.
investigations.radiographs: Baseline/follow-up hand and foot radiographs may document structural damage.

green: Exercise, joint protection, vaccination and cardiovascular/bone-health management
amber: DMARD and glucocorticoid strategies require rheumatology-led monitoring and contraindication review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Amavata is a commonly discussed correlation for some phenotypes but must not replace formal RA diagnosis and treat-to-target management.

patientEducation.summary: Chronic systemic autoimmune inflammatory arthritis that can cause persistent synovitis, erosive joint damage, disability and extra-articular disease.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for new/progressive major weakness, gait deterioration, bladder/bowel dysfunction, saddle sensory loss, fever/systemic illness with severe spinal/joint pain, major trauma, or other listed red flags.

sources.title: Recommendations for management of rheumatoid arthritis
